10 استرشى He sought, or desired, to be suchled; said of a young camel. (S, K.) ―
-b2- And استرشى مَا فِى الضَّرْعِ He drew forth what was in the udder. (Az, TA.) ―
-b3- [Hence, probably,] استرشى فِى حُكْمِهِ He sought, or desired, or demanded, a رِشْوَة [or bribe] in the case of his deciding judicially, for his doing so [agreeably with the desire of the briber]. (S, K, ↓ TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
